observations: A white and black game console, consistent with the design of a Sony PlayStation 5 'fat' model.
A disc drive slot is visible on the lower front of the console.
One white and black wireless controller is resting on the top of the unit.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic film.
The background shows a shop environment with various gaming-related boxes and accessories.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES AND' is visible on all images.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping prevents a detailed inspection of the console's surface for scratches or wear.
No screen shots of the console's library are provided; additionally, 'Fc26' is not a currently existing game title.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a display.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI output.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen on a television.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be defective.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and successfully read by the console.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or other hardware issues.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: Digital games may be tied to a personal account that the buyer will not be able to access.
risks.proof: Proof of account ownership transfer or the presence of physical game discs.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the main dashboard.
Video of a disc being inserted and recognized by the system.
Screenshot of the system storage showing the installed games.
Video of the controller in use to check for stick drift.
response.reason: The item is a PlayStation 5 Disc Edition console. It is priced as a non-working unit without games until the seller provides proof of functionality and account access. The mention of 'Fc26' is likely a typo for a current title but remains unverified.
